title: ephedra foliata var. polylepis
intro: Ephedra foliata var. polylepis, commonly known as a desert plant or Mormon tea, is a variety of Ephedra species that is native to North America. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as potential uses in managing respiratory issues and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Ephedra foliata var. polylepis are attributed to its ability to stimulate the cardiovascular system, increase energy levels, and act as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
